claim: The combination of pyrotinib, letrozole, and dalpiciclib exerted optimistic therapeutic effect in treating HER2+HR+ breast cancer in clinical trial NCT04486911.

claim: In the combination group of tamoxifen and dalpiciclib, no synergistic effect was observed.
